_comment: NVIDIA API Catalog (build.nvidia.com) Chat Completions at integrate.api.nvidia.com. Each hosted Model keeps its own reasoning control: Nemotron 3 and 3.5 read chat_template_kwargs, gpt-oss takes reasoning_effort, the rest keeps the protocol default. Controls come from NVIDIA's per-Model API reference (read 2026-11-17), not from live requests. Images are carried as image_url data URIs.

family_defaults.note: Nemotron 3 and 3.5 (Nano Omni, Lightning, Bolt, Super VL) switch reasoning with chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking (docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/nvidia-nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning, -3-5-lightning-30b-a3b, -3_5-bolt-e4b, -3_5-super-vl-120b-a12b, read 2026-11-17).

Nemotron 3 Ultra: reasoning_effort none|medium|high maps to enable_thinking false, enable_thinking with medium_effort, and enable_thinking (docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b, read 2026-11-17).
gpt-oss takes reasoning_effort low|medium|high and always reasons (docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/openai-gpt-oss-20b, read 2026-11-17).
